runs.question: Under the original RevMed-Sanofi agreement, what happens to rights and obligations that arose before the deal ended?
runs.answer:
Based on the excerpts provided, the agreement addresses what happens to rights and obligations generally upon termination, but does not contain an explicit "accrued rights/obligations survive" clause covering matters that arose before termination.

What the excerpts do show is the general rule at §12.3(a): "Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement with respect to any particular Product or country, all rights and obligations of the Parties under this Agreement with respect to such Product or country shall cease except as otherwise set forth in this Section 12.3 or elsewhere in this Agreement, but, for clarity, such termination or expiration shall not affect the Parties' rights and obligations under this Agreement with respect to the other Products or countries" [doc-001, p. 60, §12.3]. This establishes that rights/obligations cease going forward (subject to enumerated exceptions and survival provisions elsewhere in Article XII), and that termination as to one Product/country does not disturb rights and obligations for other Products/countries.

The excerpts do not contain a distinct clause stating that liabilities, obligations, or rights that had already accrued prior to termination remain enforceable notwithstanding termination. I could not find that specific language in the provided material, so I cannot confirm how pre-termination accrued rights/obligations are treated beyond the general cessation rule above.
